en: Color photograph of a large open-air stadium built almost entirely of pale stone with continuous oval seating tiers. In the center is a green football (soccer) field surrounded by a running track. On the far side, centered on the long axis, stands a prominent rectangular building with a classical colonnade and flat roof, backed by densely wooded hills under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.
